headline: Quarterly growth was mixed, with a few firms posting strong top‑line expansion while others saw modest or slowing performance.
summary: Coforge led the pack with over 50% revenue growth, driven by AI‑centric services. Mid‑tier players such as LTM, Tech Mahindra and Mphasis posted double‑digit growth, supported by AI‑led deals. Large incumbents Infosys and Wipro showed tepid revenue expansion and, in Infosys' case, trimmed FY27 guidance. Profitability varied, with HCLTech posting a 21% profit jump while Wipro's profit fell.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI contributions, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and Mphasis attributing $466 m of contracts to AI‑led deals.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% and Mphasis raised the upper end of its range, reflecting divergent expectations.
